senses.gloss: m. (cmp. קוֹלָא I, a. כִּילָה) enclosure, compartment.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:11">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>הקילא עשר אמות וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. only <he>עשר וכ׳</he>) each compartment (in Noah’s ark) was ten by ten cubits; Yalk. ib. 53 <he>כל קיל וק׳ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ מכאן וק׳ מכאן</he> one room on this, and one on the other side (of the aisle).—Pl. <he>קִילִין</he>.
